question: Which suppliers provide materials used in orders?

candidates.query: SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?m a :Material . ?p a :Product . ?o a :Order . ?s :SUPPLIES ?m . ?p :REQUIRES ?m . ?o :CONTAINS ?p . }
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?m a :Material . ?ps a :ProcessStep . ?p a :Product . ?o a :Order . ?s :SUPPLIES ?m . ?ps :USED_IN ?m . ?o :CONTAINS ?p . }

SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?m a :Material . ?l a :Lot . ?t a :Tool . ?ps a :ProcessStep . ?p a :Product . ?o a :Order . ?s :SUPPLIES ?m . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?m . ?ps :REQUIRES ?t . ?o :CONTAINS ?p . }

SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?m a :Material . ?ps a :ProcessStep . ?fab a :Fab . ?cc a :CapacityConstraint . ?inv a :Inventory . ?o a :Order . ?s :SUPPLIES ?m . ?ps :USED_IN ?m . ?inv :STOCKS ?cc . ?o :CONTAINS ?inv . }

SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a :Supplier . ?m a :Material . ?p a :Product . ?fab a :Fab . ?cc a :CapacityConstraint . ?inv a :Inventory . ?o a :Order . ?s :SUPPLIES ?m . ?p :REQUIRES ?m . ?fab :PRODUCES ?p . ?inv :STOCKS ?cc . ?o :CONTAINS ?inv . }
